The Ambassador of India to the Soviet Union from 1949 to 1952 was K. M. Panikkar (Sardar K. M. Panikkar), not "Sarabhai K. Patel." He presented his credentials in 1949 and served until 1952. The team note is inaccurate, since Panikkar was a historian and diplomat rather than an Indian Civil Service officer.
CONFIDENCE: 85
